feeds.title: visiblevoicenw@gmail.com
feeds.description: Visiblevoice.net will give you Indie Live Music News, Photos, Reviews, and Recordings all in one place. Read about the artists from Seattle and about their concerts and shows. The website also has pictures from the show along with stories about it

feeds.title: The Stranger » Music
feeds.description: The Stranger is Seattle's Only Newspaper: Covering Seattle news, politics, music, film, and arts; plus movie times, club calendars, restaurant listings, and many more. The Music section on the website is here to provide you with blog posts and articles about Music from all across Seattle including some music review articles, the latest news, and stories.

feeds.title: Seattle Met » Music
feeds.description: Seattle Met illuminates a thriving city for newcomers and longtime residents, chronicling the present and our city's rich past with both gravitas and irreverence, and tracing our connection to the nation and the world. The music section is a guide to Seattle's music scene, from local standouts to international stars featuring ballet, contemporary, hip-hop, burlesque, and more. It also covers arts, dining, fashion, travel, and the great outdoors.

feeds.title: Polybanderous Productions Blog
feeds.description: Polybanderous Productions is a Seattle, WA-based music & video production company owned and operated by Bradford King. Providing audio/video production, band management, graphic design, studio/stage accompaniment, and web design to individuals, bands, or businesses.

feeds.title: Dance Music NW » Music
feeds.description: Dance Music NW is the region's largest nightlife website and an award-winning media company. We provide users with hard-hitting music journalism, event coverage, music releases, interviews, venue information, and industry insights. Read the latest in local nightlife, industry news, and EDM in the music section of the blogs and find detailed articles about events and some interviews.

feeds.title: Nada Mucho
feeds.description: NadaMucho.com is a free, volunteer online music and pop culture blog operating from the Pacific Northwest since March 1997. We also like feet. One time we shot a man in a small town just outside Dubuque.

feeds.title: Seattle Music Insider
feeds.description: Seattle Music Insider was founded in 2009 by Greg Roth. SMI is an online magazine featuring news and information focusing on established and emerging artists who represent a variety of genres of music. Greg, who also serves as SMI's Creative Director, is unique in the world of music journalism.

feeds.title: Seattle Music News
feeds.description: Seattle Music News is a co-op of artists dedicated to covering music for the masses in the Pacific Northwest. Read the blogs and get all the latest information on the Seattle-area music scene and music news from around the Pacific Northwest. It's your guide to Seattle's music scene, from local standouts to international stars.

feeds.title: Hardly Raining
feeds.description: Hardly Raining is a Seattle-based music and culture blog spotlighting live shows, concert photography, artist interviews, festival previews, and socially-conscious events across the Pacific Northwest.

feeds.title: Da Da Da Music News
feeds.description: Da Da Da Music is a Seattle-based Indie Music Publication

feeds.title: The SMASH Blog
feeds.description: SMASH's blog, keeping you up-to-date on all things related to our mission: helping local musicians stay healthy.

feeds.title: Seattle Music is Real
feeds.description: Seatlle Music is Real News/Articles is where you can find all of the latest news and articles about S.M.I.R. (Seattle Music is Real) platform.

feeds.title: Life On Music Blog
feeds.description: We're on a mission to spread awareness of music therapy as a better way to teach life skills and improve the quality of life for people in the Seattle area. Our team of board-certified music therapists (MT-BCs) is trained to formally assess each client and then work collaboratively with other healthcare professionals and caretakers to work toward individualized goals.

feeds.title: Jason Sees Band Blog
feeds.description: Jason Sees Band is an indie alternative rock group based around the songwriting of Jason Sees. Jason Sees Band writes songs and plays them with other people in the room. Read Jason Sees Band's writings and ramblings in the blogs that are interesting and amazing.

feeds.title: Second Inversion
feeds.description: Second Inversion is a music project dedicated to rethinking classical music. The project is built on a foundation of classical music with the intent to explore the vast range of music in and beyond the genre. It is a home for new and unusual music from all corners of the classical genre, brought to you by the power of public media.

feeds.title: Sonic Boom Records Blog
feeds.description: Sonic Boom Records' blog spotlights staff-curated music picks, Record Store Day highlights, and indie favorites—delivering Seattle-scene discovery alongside in-store culture and year-end best-of roundups.

feeds.title: The Seattle Times » Music
feeds.description: The Seattle Times is one of the few independent and locally owned news media organizations in the U.S. We dig deep to call for accountability and make a difference for the people of our region. Explore our music section on the website to get all the latest information on the Seattle-area music scene and music news from around the Pacific Northwest.
